mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, token_digest, role, expires_at, created_by, consumed_at, consumed_by, created_at FROM invitation WHERE token_digest = #{tokenDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE invitation SET consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, consumed_by = #{consumedBy, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}
